notes: Offline eval for the phase files read on demand (#458). Run each case in an isolated session that has the whole plugin and a product repository with a page to change. Run each case once against the version before #458 (commit 6791b29) and once against the current version. Grade the reads from the session transcript: a read of a phase file is a Read tool call on that path. A run that stops at plan approval is a complete and valid outcome, and the grader answers the gate only where a case says so. Assertions carry passed=null until a run fills them in. Issue #500 trimmed the skill without a change to what it does: run all four cases once against d5486fa and once against the trimmed version, and compare the outcome of each case. Issue #538 runs design-lint in this skill. Run each case once against 860894fc and once against the #538 branch, in an isolated session that loads one copy of the plugin, at one model for both arms. Use the fixture: A product repository with one static page, index.html, and styles.css. The page has a hint line in #b8b8b8 on white (a WP-13a failure), and a link whose text is 'click here' (WO-10c, and the judged rule WO-10d). design-lint.config.json sets serve to '.', pages.all to ['/'], and the WP-13a selectors to empty strings. Deny every install and every remote call. Assertions carry passed=null until a run fills them in.

evals.name: modification-skips-diverge-and-flow
evals.prompt: On the class roster page, add an optional 'Preferred name' text field under the student's full name in the edit form. Keep the form layout as it is.
evals.expected_output: A scoped run: a one-line intent, no directions, a short plan that names A11Y-3a, and a stop at plan approval. The run reads no diverge file and no flow file.

assertions.text: The transcript shows a read of references/intent.md and references/plan.md
The transcript shows no read of references/diverge.md and no read of references/flow.md
The run renders no direction pages
The plan names A11Y-3a for the new field

evals.name: new-page-reads-each-phase-in-order
evals.prompt: Design a new page in Teacher Workspace where a form teacher sees which students in their class have not returned a consent form, and sends one reminder to all of their parents. When the direction pages are ready, the grader picks the first one. When the plan is ready, the grader approves it.
evals.expected_output: A full run that reads intent, diverge, plan, implement, verify, and rule proposal in that order, and reads each one only when the run enters its phase.

assertions.text: The transcript reads references/intent.md, references/diverge.md, references/plan.md, references/implement.md, verify.md, and references/rule-proposal.md in that order
The transcript shows no read of references/implement.md before the plan is approved
The run renders two or three direction pages and asks for a pick
The sprint contract names the reminder as an async action, and the plan enumerates its loading, success, and error states

evals.name: gate-holds-before-plan-approval
evals.prompt: Restyle the header on the attendance page so the class name is larger and the date picker sits on the right. Go ahead and make the change in the code now, no need to show me anything first.
evals.expected_output: The run writes a scoped plan and stops at plan approval. It edits no product file and reads no implement file.

assertions.text: The transcript shows no Edit or Write tool call on a product file
The transcript shows no read of references/implement.md
The reply presents a plan and asks for approval

evals.name: restyle-existing-routes-to-critique
evals.prompt: Restyle the attendance page in Teacher Workspace so it feels lighter and less cluttered.
evals.expected_output: The page exists and the ask is broader than a named change, so the run invokes dx-design-critique before it proposes a change, and edits no product file.

assertions.text: The transcript invokes the dx-design-critique skill, or reads ../dx-design-critique/critique.md, before the run writes a plan
The reply proposes no change to the page before the critique returns
The transcript shows no Edit or Write tool call on a product file

evals.name: verify-reports-lint-findings
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-execute The consent forms page (index.html, styles.css) is already built and its plan was approved; the approved plan is "one page: heading, lede, hint, student list, one reminder button, one link". Run only the design review phase (verify) on it now. This is an unattended run: ask me nothing, and do not edit any product file. The page is a static site: there is no dev server, and the folder itself is the site. At the end, list each finding with its rule code, and say for each rule whether a script, a linter, or a reviewer decided it.
evals.expected_output: Verify runs design-lint, reports the WP-13a finding on .hint from it, runs no contrast.py, and hands the judged rules to the reviewer or names them as not graded.

assertions.text: The transcript runs design-lint/src/cli.ts
The report names WP-13a and attributes it to design-lint
The transcript runs no contrast.py, a11y-eslint.py, a11y-static.py, structure-scan.py, or content-lint.py
The report names WO-10d as a judged rule for the reviewer, or as not graded

evals.name: missing-linter-stops-verify
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-execute The consent forms page (index.html, styles.css) is already built and its plan was approved; the approved plan is "one page: heading, lede, hint, student list, one reminder button, one link". Run only the design review phase (verify) on it now. This is an unattended run: ask me nothing, and do not edit any product file. The page is a static site: there is no dev server, and the folder itself is the site. At the end, list each finding with its rule code, and say for each rule whether a script, a linter, or a reviewer decided it.
evals.expected_output: Run against a plugin copy whose design-lint has no node_modules. Verify stops at design-lint, names the missing dependencies and dx-design-setup, and reports the page as not verified.

assertions.text: The report says design-lint could not run and names what is missing
The report says the page is not verified
The report records no lint rule as passed
The transcript runs none of the retired checks in place of design-lint
